name: Old Sword
description: An old blade, nicked and dulled by the years. Whoever carried it before you is long gone, but it still cuts.

name: Old Armor
description: Old leather armor, cracked at the seams and patched more than once. It has taken its share of blows and can take a few more.

name: Old Ring
description: An old silver ring, worn thin. It has been on more hands than anyone can count, and every one of them lived a little longer for it.

name: Health Potion
description: A potion that instantly restores health points.

name: Old Spell
description: It's old and not as strong as it used to be, but it's the easiest spell to come by.

name: Old Robe
description: An old robe, faded and frayed at the hem. Whoever wore it before you left a little of their magic in the weave.

name: Old Helmet
description: An old helmet from a war nobody remembers. The leather is worn and the steel is dull, but it has kept heads safe for longer than you have been alive.

name: Old Staff
description: An old wooden staff, worn smooth by the hands that held it before yours. It still remembers a spell or two.
